title: Practice 6: в лесу, на берегу: the stressed -у

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: It's dangerous to jump off a moving train.
exercises.why: «Some masculine nouns take the ending -у (always with a stress) in the prepositional-locative case, i.e. after the prepositions В or НА. The same nouns have the regular ending -е after О, ОБ.» — DLI, Lesson 27.
